name: Nagagutsu o Haita Deco
source:
When Kosuke wakes up, he finds himself being in a strange house. He meets a girl wearing boots called Hamu there. According to her, her family members suddenly went missing, and she's been living with her pet cat since then. He starts living there to take care of her. But, he gradually becomes doubtful about the situation he is currently involved.... 

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
耕介醒来后，发现自己身处一栋陌生的房子，并在那里遇见了穿长靴的少女哈姆。据她所说，家人突然全部失踪，从那以后，她一直与宠物猫相依为命。为了照顾她，耕介开始住在这里。然而，他渐渐对自己卷入的状况产生了怀疑……

[摘自Himeya Shop]
